content: ककुद् {%f.%} .²1 A summit, peak. .²2 Chief, head; see ककुद below; अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत् <ls>Rv. 8. 44. 16</ls>. .²3 The hump on the shoulders of the Indian bull; ककुद्दोषणी याचते महादेवः <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls n="P.">VI. 1. 63</ls>. ककुदे वृषस्य कृतबाहुम् <ls>Ki. 12. 20</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 22</ls>. .²4 A horn. .²5 An ensign or symbol of royalty (as the छत्र, चामर <ab>&c.</ab>); ‘ककुद्वत्ककुदं श्रेष्ठे वृषाङ्के राजलक्ष्मणि’ इति विश्वः; नृपतिककुदं दत्त्वा यूने सितातपवारणम् <ls>R. 3. 70</ls>. .²6 Any projecting corner; <ls>Bhāg. 5. 25. 7</ls>. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Dharma. According to <ls>Pāṇini V. 4. 146-147</ls> ककुद् is the form to be substituted for ककुद in <ab>adj.</ab> or <ab>Bah. comps.</ab>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} त्रिककुद्.
